Read a recorded step test

Source: R/sheet.R
read_recording.Rd

Reads a test recorded with the web form of recording_sheet() (an .xlsx with the sheets stages, recovery and test), or a CSV in the columns of the template, and returns what lactate_threshold() and test_report() need. Needs the readxl package for an .xlsx.

Usage

read_recording(file)

Arguments

file

The .xlsx downloaded from the form, or a .csv.

Value

a list with

  • stages: one row per stage, the resting sample first, with intensity, lactate, heart_rate and rpe (and clock_time and notes from the form). When the form has a "time in the last stage" shorter than the stage duration, the intensity of the last stage is time-weighted, as lactate_threshold(last_stage_duration = ) does, and a message says so. A last step that is already smaller than the one before is taken as weighted and kept;

  • recovery: the recovery samples (time, in minutes, and lactate) for the Stegmann threshold, or NULL;

  • athlete: name, date, sex, age and body_mass, as recorded, for test_report(athlete = ) or report_header();

  • sport, sample, rpe_scale, stage_duration (min), site and grade (%), for lactate_threshold(): "cycling", "blood" and "6-20" when not recorded, and NULL for the others;

  • protocol: the protocol in one line, for test_report(protocol = ), or NULL;

  • details: every field of the form, as text.

See also

recording_sheet() for the form.

Examples

## a test recorded with the CSV template
file <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
write.csv(demo_data[c("intensity", "lactate", "heart_rate", "rpe")], file, row.names = FALSE)
test <- read_recording(file)
results <- lactate_threshold(
  test$stages, intensity, lactate, heart_rate, rpe_column = rpe, plot = FALSE
)
